answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1745 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the zephyr. The harbor index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the horizon queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Bonded capital sits idle for 9 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
